properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-29: "Let's do c, then a." (c) Hold the sweep until increment 2's cues are built, so the sweep measures reflow2 with its cues working rather than the pilot's un-cued reader. Then (a) a made-up project with its own key, at a moderate size, three to five times the pilot's 60 documents, rather than ten times. Considered and not chosen: (b) a real design (SeattleArch copy or reflow2's own), whose key would have to be checked by hand.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-29: the size sweep (increment 9) waits until the cue build is in, then runs on a made-up project three to five times the pilot's size with its own answer key
properties.rationale:
Increment 8 showed the deciding factor under a budget was whether the reader was cued to the current-state record (5.5 → 17.5 of 25 with one line), so a sweep before the cues exist would mostly re-measure that missing cue. A made-up corpus keeps a trustworthy key; three to five times keeps the cost bounded while still passing well beyond what a notes file can hold in one read.
